draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Shirdi! This town was home to Sai Baba, the 19th-century saint, and his Samadhi Mandir is just a 3 min walk from here. Millions of devotees come every year, from all over India and abroad.
draft.hungryLine: Keep it Maharashtrian with a plate of kanda pohe and tea, or a spicy misal pav or vada pav with garlic chutney.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Shri Sai Baba Temple, also called the Samadhi Mandir, is a 3 min walk. It's the heart of town and the reason everyone's here.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Find a quiet corner near the temple complex and just soak in the devotion around you.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Shirdi goes by a second name too, Sainagar.

spots.name: Shri Sai Baba Temple
spots.detail: 3 min walk · Sai Baba's Samadhi Mandir, one of India's most visited pilgrimage sites

tips.title: Go early to beat the crowds.
tips.body: The temple draws millions of devotees every year, so it's rarely quiet.

tips.title: Look for both names.
tips.body: Signs may say Shirdi or Sainagar, they're the same town in Rahata taluka.

story.title: The saint's home
story.body: Sai Baba, the 19th-century saint, made Shirdi his home. The town in Rahata taluka became known for him.

story.title: The Samadhi Mandir
story.body: A temple complex grew up around Sai Baba's samadhi, known as the Shri Saibaba Samadhi Mandir.

story.title: A pilgrim town
story.body: Shirdi is now one of the most visited pilgrimage sites in India, with devotees coming from across the country and abroad.
